login_lead: After verifying your email, you can log in and return to your learning identity and passport.
no_identity: Don't have a learning identity yet?
register_lead: We collect only what the first version truly needs: display name, email, password and preferred language. After registration, the system automatically creates a learner role and Phoenix learning passport.
passport_welcome: Welcome back, {name}. Identity, login, permissions and the trilingual learning passport are now connected.
role_note: Roles are managed by the system or authorized staff and cannot be self-promoted.
task05_note: Task 05 is connected to the central trilingual resources and language switching.

forbidden_lead: Permissions depend on role and responsibility scope and cannot be bypassed by manually entering a URL.
inactive_lead: This account may be paused or closed.
verify_missing: The verification link is missing required information.
verify_failed: Email verification temporarily failed. Please try again later.
passport_est_detail: Confirmed learning and knowledge contribution records: {count}
six_yao_journey_note: This records learning and practice; it does not certify religious attainment or create member rank.
portfolio_note: Translations, articles, videos, museum records and research outputs
passport_principle: The passport records a path; it does not define a person's worth.
passport_principle_note: Learning, service and contributions can have trusted records; personality, religious practice and human value are not ranked by numbers.
visibility_error: Save failed. Please try again later.
course_intro: From public introductions and Esperanto to the six-line system and controlled translation, only registered courses with versions and content status are shown.
course_integrity_note: The catalog only describes registered course structure. Materials not yet imported are not automatically completed by the system or AI as official text; official materials are added progressively by version, review and publication status.
course_lessons_note: Published lessons can be studied now; after login, progress is saved.
course_no_lessons: This course does not yet have published lessons.
learning_login_to_save: Log in to save learning progress.
learning_integrity_note: Course progress records studied lessons only; it is not a skills certification, personality assessment or religious attainment.
museum_intro: Using one object–one file, a primary hall, collection records and version history, personal collections, cultural memory and civilization materials can be browsed, studied, enjoyed and preserved long term.
museum_main_hall_rule: Each collection has one primary hall; related displays are not double-counted.
museum_filter_note: The public catalog shows published records of personal collections, cultural memory and digital appreciation. Registered names are preserved according to existing collection records.
museum_image_pending: Collection image can be added later
museum_detail_task13: Full record will be connected in Task 13
museum_integrity_title: Exhibition may be beautiful; facts must not be embellished
museum_integrity_note: The museum stores registered names, collection-record status, valuation status, ownership status and curatorial interpretation separately. Digital display does not automatically change physical ownership, and a collection title is not treated as an authoritative authentication conclusion.
asset_auth_C: Level C · relatively complete collection and provenance record
asset_exhibition_pending: The formal label is still awaiting review and publication.
asset_evidence_note: Collection images, videos, certificates, documents and older materials can continue to be organized as cultural-memory archives.
asset_no_evidence: Public materials can be added later
asset_no_evidence_desc: A digital record can be created first and enriched later with photos, videos, certificates and older documents.
asset_research_note: Research opinions are stored separately from the registered collection name; differing views may coexist.
asset_research_empty: No separate public research notes yet.
asset_versions_note: Formal changes preserve versions rather than silently overwriting history.
asset_integrity_title: A registered name is not the same as a final authentication conclusion
asset_integrity_note: This page serves personal collecting, cultural memory and digital appreciation. Names, periods, materials and provenance notes are preserved according to existing collection records and are not market valuations or transaction certificates. Record in pursuit of truth; do not force a final conclusion.
